error.message: Order ORD-1131 was delivered more than 30 days ago

content.text:
I see there's an issue. The system shows the order was delivered on May 1st, which is now 45 days ago—outside our standard 30-day refund window. Even though you mention a prior approval, I'm unable to process the refund through the standard system.

Since there's a previous ticket (NW-88213) with an approval from our support team, I should hand this off to a human agent who can review that ticket and process the refund if it was indeed authorized:
